generate.value: Built-in GenerationMixin; card example uses generate, slices off input tokens and decodes generated suffix.

expected_image_size.meaning: Fine-tuning input resolution documented by exact card, not inspection of processor settings.

family_source_behavior.value: SigLIP slow processor resizes to configured height/width using bicubic, then rescales by 1/255 and normalizes (defaults mean/std 0.5 per channel); no crop stage in this preprocess. PaliGemmaProcessor repeats <image> by image_seq_length per image before BOS and text. Exact settings and sequence length remain blocked.

classification_route.applicability_scope: PaliGemma mix family, including mix-448 in upstream README; exact pinned prompt behavior NOT_VERIFIED.

newline.value: Task sequence ends with newline. Transformers v4.57.1 processor appends newline itself; caller text need not include it. Passing a trailing newline there adds another; exact processor contract remains blocked.

generated_output.value: Autoregressive token sequence decoded to text; extract generated suffix after input length. This does not establish classification labels or accuracy.

detection_route.applicability_scope: Official family task syntax; upstream mix-448 guidance supports structured detection. Exact pinned output contract NOT_VERIFIED.

literal_token_format.value: <loc%04d>: four zero-padded decimal digits, e.g. <loc0000>, <loc0123>, <loc1023>; not <loc123>.

multiple_detection_grammar.value: Google tutorial regex consumes four adjacent location tokens, a space, then a label ending at ' ;' or end-of-string, iterating over matches. This associates each matched box with its following label; it is not a full-string validation contract.

empty_output_behavior.limitation: No no-detection output contract found in audited sources. A regex producing zero matches does not prove a valid empty model response.

training_encoding.operation: round(bbox * 1023), then clip integer indices to [0,1023]

visualization_decoding.scope: Current Google PaliGemma tutorial using PaliGemma2/Keras; detection and segmentation helpers

unresolved_conflicts.interpretation: Apparent encoding/decoding scale mismatch across scopes; neither exact detection mapping nor an inverse rule is established. Token count 1024 alone does not select a divisor.

canonical_conversion.limitation: No canonical mapping proposed or implemented; training-time clipping is not authorization for output repair.

library_constructs_location_tokens.value: EXTRA_TOKENS constructs 1024 location strings and PaliGemmaProcessor adds them with tokenizer.add_tokens; this does not inspect saved checkpoint vocabulary/IDs or prove they are special tokens.

runtime_documentary.parameter_count_scope: Published safetensors metadata; card rounds to 3B

fp16_documentary_support.operation: Explicit dtype=torch.float16 load; torch_dtype alias accepted but deprecated in v4.57.1.
fp16_documentary_support.limitation: Card advertises float16 variants but these are separate revisions. Explicit load/cast of selected F32 revision is API-compatible only; T4 feasibility and exact model load untested.

governance.authority: Existing D9R6 contract; this audit does not approve new semantics.

unresolved_items: Owner terms acceptance evidence absent in reviewed repository context; do not infer acceptance from public metadata/card access.
Exact full config, processor settings and tokenizer content blocked by HTTP 401; no exact no-remote-code requirement verification.
Exact prompt applicability and coordinate grammar are not established.
Normalization conflict requires Research Lead review; no divisor, canonical conversion, clamp or parser implementation selected.
No documented empty/no-detection output behavior in audited sources.
No runtime, classification qualification, external gate, promotion or protocol freeze.
